title: Ganexity Structured Phone Lead Summary
description: A structured summary for a phone lead captured by Ganexity, a Spanish-first AI phone receptionist for local businesses in Spain.

business_name.description: The business that received the call.

call_datetime.description: The call date and time in ISO 8601 format, including timezone when available.

phone_number.description: The caller's phone number, preferably in international format when available.

requested_service.description: A concise description of what the caller requested.

product_or_service_category.description: The broad category for the request, such as kitchens, bathrooms, reforms, furniture, clinic appointment request, or local service enquiry.

city_or_zone.description: The city, neighborhood, service area, or zone mentioned by the caller.

urgency.description: The practical urgency of the request.

existing_customer.description: Whether the caller appears to be an existing customer. Null means unknown.

preferred_contact_method.description: The caller's preferred method for follow-up.

preferred_callback_time.description: The preferred callback time, if the caller provided one.

notes.description: Important notes, preferences, context, or constraints mentioned during the call.

missing_information.description: Important details that were not captured and may need to be requested by human staff.

human_follow_up_required.description: Whether a human should review and follow up on the lead.

recommended_next_action.description: A concise recommendation for the business team.

confidence_score.description: The assistant's confidence in the extracted summary, from 0 to 1.
